# MDD Sim Gateway v1.6.1-rc2

## 中文

这是面向 Issue #21、#30 报告者的候选测试版本，不会进入稳定版自动更新通道。

### 请重点验证

- 长时间运行后，VoWiFi 是否仍会自行停止且不恢复。
- 手动重启、关闭/开启 VoWiFi、拔插卡或切换 eSIM 后，线路能否按预期恢复。
- 问题复现后请直接生成新的脱敏支持包；即使随后关闭 VoWiFi，恢复调度、阻断、失败或取消原因也应保留在独立 lifecycle 记录中。
- 分享支持包前仍请人工检查内容。

### 本候选版本的修复

- 修复 modem bridge 临时读不到 IMEI 时覆盖已验证身份、进而导致自动恢复被 `hardware_imei_required` 阻断的问题。
- 持久化自动恢复的调度、开始、成功、失败、阻断和取消事件；相同的无卡阻断会合并，避免淹没故障历史。
- lifecycle 写盘移出 asyncio 事件循环，并与大型诊断快照使用独立锁。
- 支持包增加身份健康布尔状态、日志覆盖索引、IKE head+tail、10 MiB 上限及严格脱敏回归。
- 通话事件仅解析最后 20,000 行，manifest 会标明未扫描的历史前缀。

本版本需要同时更新 Control 与 Engine。验证通过后将以 v1.6.1 稳定版重新发布。

---

## English

This is a release candidate for the reporters of Issues #21 and #30. It is not promoted to the stable automatic-update channel.

### Please verify

- Whether VoWiFi still stops by itself and fails to recover after long-running use.
- Whether manual restart, VoWiFi toggles, card removal/reinsertion, and eSIM switching recover as expected.
- Generate a new redacted support bundle immediately after reproduction. Recovery scheduling, blocking, failure, or cancellation should now survive a later VoWiFi toggle in the lifecycle log.
- Continue to review the bundle manually before sharing it.

### Candidate fixes

- Preserve a verified modem IMEI across transient bridge refresh failures so recovery is not incorrectly blocked by `hardware_imei_required`.
- Persist structured recovery scheduling, start, success, failure, blocking, and cancellation decisions while coalescing repeated no-card blocks.
- Move lifecycle writes off the asyncio event loop and isolate them from large diagnostic rewrites.
- Add identity-health booleans, per-log coverage, IKE head+tail retention, a 10 MiB ceiling, and redaction regression coverage to support bundles.
- Parse only the latest 20,000 call-event lines and report any unscanned prefix in the manifest.

Both Control and Engine are updated in this candidate. A stable v1.6.1 will follow after validation.
